## Rodolfo is a lifesaver. Top tier customer service!
I cannot recommend FlowBots and Replikanto enough, and a huge part of that is because of their customer support. Rodolfo Machado helped me through a frustrating licensing and Machine ID issue after a NinjaTrader update and reinstall. He was incredibly fast, patient, and walked me through exactly what I needed to do with my log files and User Defined ID to get back up and running. Later, when I had a hotkey issue, he honestly and quickly pointed me toward the correct NinjaTrader settings rather than giving me the runaround. A+ software and A+ support. Thanks, Rodolfo!

Sep 15, 2026 [...] Thank you for your feedback, and we're sorry your experience with Replikanto has been frustrating.  
  
We'd like to clear up one point for you and for other readers: a Replikanto Lifetime license does not expire. It keeps working with the version you have, with no further payment required. Every paid license includes 1 year of free product updates and technical support. After that year, customers who want newer versions and continued support can add the optional "Technical Support +1 Year" package for 39 USD. Buying it is entirely your choice and is not required to keep using Replikanto. This is how our licensing has always worked, and it is described on the product page and in our Terms and Conditions.
